text: Meet the Cloud Family. I'm your narrator.
I'm Ravi. Appa. I work in IT, and my salary disappears by the twentieth.
I'm Meena. I run this house's budget. Says who? Show me the numbers.
I'm Arjun! Options trading, crypto, ten x in one month, bro!
I'm Paati. Gold and fixed deposits never cheated me, kanna.
I'm Thatha. Let me tell you about the Sensex in nineteen ninety two.
Kasi Mama here. I have a sure-shot tip for you. Ten thousand becomes one lakh!
